A subsection is a link to its first page and opens onto its own pages only while it holds the current one, so the list stays short however many pages the section has. The current page is marked with `aria-current` rather than the `active` class, which the theme's scrollspy clears from every link in the sidebar as the reader scrolls. The card scrolls on its own, held inside the window under the top bar, so the end of a long contents list stays in reach while the sidebar sticks. The bundled theme's rule for that names `.bs-sidebar.card`, a class pair no element carries, and the head is left as the bundled theme writes it, so the limit is an attribute here. A heading that names a dotted path breaks inside the path, since a scrolling card would otherwise scroll sideways to show it whole. -#} {%- macro first_page(section) -%} {%- for target in nav.pages if section in target.ancestors %}{% if loop.first %}{{ target.url|url }}{% endif %} {%- endfor %} {%- endmacro %} {%- macro area_entry(item) %}
